description: React component for managing and viewing conversation history in a chat interface, including features such as loading, viewing, exporting, searching, and deleting conversations.

methods.name: loadConversations
methods.description: Loads conversation history, currently with mock data

methods.name: viewConversation
methods.description: Displays detailed messages of a selected conversation

methods.name: deleteConversation
methods.description: Deletes a specified conversation from history

methods.name: exportConversation
methods.description: Exports a conversation as a JSON file

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats ISO date strings into a human-readable format
